evidence.reason: The current review builder only adds `commit_id` when `hunkMap !== null`; the body-only retry passes `hunks=null`, so the review payload omits `commit_id`. GitHub then defaults to the PR's latest commit, which may be a newer head than the `base..head` range and findings described in the review body. That breaks exact-head review semantics. The fix is routine: include the reviewed `head` as `commit_id` regardless of inline-hunk availability, and surface a failure if GitHub rejects that commit rather than attaching the review to another head.
